title: The Third Portrait
author: Oscar Oyelaran
blurb: Casper Sterling, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
